title: stacked triangles are tetrahedral — a machine-checked theorem of the ℤ/9 vortex deposit
description:
stacked triangles are tetrahedral, declared in src/proof/merkaba.lean and accepted by the Lean 4 kernel, sorry-free and axiom-free, closing by by decide.

Statement (Lean):

(List.range' 1 40).all (fun n => sumTri n == n * (n + 1) * (n + 2) / 6)

\forall n \in \{1,\dots,40\},\; \mathrm{sumTri}\mathopen{}\left(n\right) = \frac{n \cdot n + 1 \cdot n + 2}{6}
